title: Let CSP Be Your ANCHOR: Adaptive Crystal Search over Frozen Structure Priors
abstract: arXiv:2609.33407v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: De novo crystal generation (DNG) models decide where to search in composition space and how to generate structures with one set of weights. We argue that discovery is better served by separating the two. A crystal structure prediction (CSP) model is a physical prior that should be improved by likelihood training, while rewards, including novelty measured against the search's own history, should act on a search over compositions. We introduce ANCHOR, a GRPO composition policy trained with multi-objective rewards around a frozen CSP model, and continuous adaptive novelty (CAN), a graded novelty score against known structures and a growing discovery history. Using the frozen CSP model as a fixed ruler under one evaluator, we test where adaptation should act. Replacing DNG compositions with ANCHOR's policy on the same CSP backbone raises MSUN from 11.4% to 47.6% and SUN from 1.1% to 22.1% at 99.9% formula uniqueness. Fine-tuning DN

translated_title: 让CSP成为你的锚点：在冻结结构先验之上的自适应晶体搜索
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.33407v2 公告类型：replace-cross。摘要：从头晶体生成（DNG）模型用同一组权重既决定在组分空间中搜索的位置，又决定如何生成结构。我们认为，将二者分离更有利于材料发现。晶体结构预测（CSP）模型是一种物理先验，应通过似然训练加以改进；而奖励（包括相对于搜索自身历史所度量的新颖性）则应作用于组分空间上的搜索。我们提出了ANCHOR——一种围绕冻结CSP模型、以多目标奖励训练的GRPO组分策略，以及连续自适应新颖性（CAN）——一种针对已知结构和不断增长的发现历史的分级新颖性评分。以冻结的CSP模型作为同一评估器下的固定标尺，我们测试了自适应应当作用于何处。在相同的CSP骨干上，用ANCHOR的策略替代DNG的组分选择，在99.9%化学式唯一性的条件下，将MSUN从11.4%提升至47.6%，将SUN从1.1%提升至22.1%。微调DN（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将物理先验与组分搜索解耦的ANCHOR框架：冻结CSP模型作为固定的结构生成器，通过多目标奖励训练的GRPO组分策略和连续自适应新颖性评分（CAN）来指导组分搜索，在99.9%化学式唯一性下将MSUN从11.4%大幅提升至47.6%。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes ANCHOR, which decouples physical priors from composition search by keeping the CSP model frozen as a structural generator while training a GRPO composition policy with multi-objective rewards and a continuous adaptive novelty score (CAN), raising MSUN from 11.4% to 47.6% at 99.9% formula uniqueness.
